snippet.title: Give Him a Break! - Gameplay Trailer (free demo on Steam)
snippet.description:
You don't play the cat. You hold the laser pointer, and he decides what the evening costs: every vase, chair and sofa he breaks goes on the owner's receipt. Break enough and you pick a card - Mind Control, Fire Cat, Blue Laser, 9 Lives, Big Trouble and more - and see how high the bill goes in a one-minute round.

Free demo out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5313430/Give_him_a_break/
Also on itch: https://corbygamesstudio.itch.io/give-him-a-break

X: https://x.com/corbygames
